title: No-Armor Shine
description: I turned off the armor shine in Minecraft by using a texture pack, and honestly it made the game feel way cleaner. Before, the shiny glint on armor was kind of distracting, especially when I was trying to focus during fights or just look at my character.
body: I turned off the armor shine in Minecraft by using a texture pack, and honestly it made the game feel way cleaner. Before, the shiny glint on armor was kind of distracting, especially when I was trying to focus during fights or just look at my character. After disabling it, everything looks more simple and realistic.
